product: Quick Product Video / Studio Video Builder

promoted_rule.before: The renderer could mark a video as created after MediaRecorder stopped even if chunks were empty or the WEBM blob was unusably small.
promoted_rule.after: The renderer now blocks success when chunks are missing or blob.size is below minimumUsefulVideoBytes(duration). It shows an error, does not expose download/share as success, and records local render proof only after passing the non-empty gate.
promoted_rule.rollback: Revert commit ae628d8a4c20c9636458274c335a010368d2d221 if Android Chrome produces valid playable WEBM below this threshold. Replace threshold with device-calibrated value instead of removing the gate.

regression_checks.expected: status error, outputBlob null, no success message
status error, fileInfo shows QA block and minimum bytes
video src set, download href set, local render proof stored, success status says non-empty WEBM gate passed

rejected_weak_patterns: Do not count 'Video sukurtas' as proof unless blob size is above threshold.
Do not sell or outreach from a summary/policy/audit without a playable downloaded file.
Do not hide Android Chrome failures behind generic success text.

kpi_effect.confirmed_quality_change: Reduced false-positive render success risk for the P0 product.
kpi_effect.remaining_sell_ready_blocker: A real Android Chrome manual test must still prove photos load, preview renders, non-empty WEBM generates, video plays, and download succeeds.

next_executable_task: Run Android Chrome manual QA on the live GitHub Pages URL and paste the localStorage studioVideoLastRenderProof payload plus downloaded file size into OPS/qa. If pass, open the revenue gate for a 19 EUR one-off video pack or 49 EUR/month seller plan test.
